data.name: Somewhere in İstanbul
data.detailed_description:
Somewhere in Istanbul! is an atmosphere-driven survival and exploration game set in an Istanbul that has fallen into a haunting silence following a massive disaster.

The city is no longer what it used to be. Among ruined streets, abandoned buildings, and unknown dangers, there is only one goal: to survive.

Resources are extremely scarce. Threats roaming the environment can hunt you down at any moment, just as easily as hunger, thirst, and exhaustion. Every bullet is precious, and every decision can lead to irreversible consequences. To stay safe, you will scavenge for food, gather usable materials, craft equipment, and establish secure shelters.

While navigating maps inspired by real districts of Istanbul, you won't just wander through an abandoned city; you will also witness the stories of the people left behind in the wake of the disaster. The notes, recordings, and environmental storytelling you discover will reveal what happened behind the scenes, step by step.

Key Features:

  • Resource gathering, crafting, and inventory management.

  • Melee and firearm combat mechanics.

  • A tension-filled atmosphere and dynamic environmental hazards.

  • Detailed regions inspired by actual locations in Istanbul.

  • Environmental storytelling and exploration-based progression.

  • A constantly shifting risk-reward balance, offering a unique experience with every expedition.

Supported by a minimal user interface, cinematic visuals, and atmospheric music, the game aims to keep the player constantly on edge. Sometimes silence is the greatest threat; other times, a single sound you hear tells you it's time to run.

The city awaits you. But remember... People forget. The earth does not.

data.short_description: An atmosphere-driven survival and exploration game set in an Istanbul fallen into silence after a massive disaster. Face dangers in ruined streets, manage scarce resources, craft essential gear, and fight to stay alive in maps inspired by real locations of the city.

pc_requirements.minimum:
Minimum:
  • OS: Win 10/11
  • Processor: Intel Core i5-4460 / AMD Ryzen 3 1200
  • Memory: 8 GB RAM
  • Graphics: NVIDIA® GeForce® GTX 1060 6GB / AMD Radeon™ RX 580 8GB / Intel® Arc A380
  • Storage: 45 GB available space
  • Sound Card: DirectX uyumlu

content_descriptors.notes: This game centers around a post-disaster survival struggle and features scenes where players must engage in combat with hostile threats to stay alive. Throughout the game, there are frequent depictions of intense violence, blood, and physical injuries resulting from melee and firearm combat. The post-earthquake ruins and debris also contain tragic scenes and visually distressing environments. The game does not contain any sexual content, drug abuse, or self-harm themes.
